digests.summary: Aaj ka digest mein only court rulings hain, zyada tar GST aur income tax ke recent cases par. Official announcements nahi hain, sirf trade press se news hai, toh business owners abhi direct action na le, lekin apne cases aur notices ko check kar lein.

items.headline: SGST notice ke baad bhi pehle CGST case valid: Delhi HC
items.detail: Delhi HC ne bola ki agar CGST ki proceedings pehle shuru hui thi, toh baad mein aayi SGST notice se wo nullify nahi hoti. Section 6(2)(b) ka aisa koi bar nahi hai.
items.cga_view: Agar aapke against pehle CGST aur baad mein SGST notice aya hai, toh dono ki validity check karen—sirf is base pe challenge na karein ki ek authority already action le chuki thi.

items.headline: GST refund delay pe interest milega, naya certificate nahi chahiye: Telangana HC
items.detail: Telangana HC ne bola ki agar refund pe interest claim karna hai aur refund already sanction ho chuka hai, toh dubara certification ki zarurat nahi.
items.cga_view: Agar GST refund aapko late mila hai, toh bina kisi extra document ke interest claim request karein. Bas sanctioned refund proof ready rakhein.

items.headline: ITR me galat exemption section bhara? Section 10(26AAB) benefit phir bhi mil sakta hai
items.detail: ITAT Lucknow ne bola ki agar taxpayer ne galat section me exemption claim kiya but eligible hai, toh AO ko sahi section dekh ke benefit dena chahiye.
items.cga_view: Agar aap ya aapka client galti se ITR me exemption ki galat section bhar deta hai, toh eligibility proof ke saath AO ke samne apni claim present karein.

digests.summary: Aaj ka digest mein key court rulings aur income tax ke practical points cover kiye gaye hain. Sab items high-impact aur relevant hain, trade press se liye gaye kyunki aaj official release nahi aayi.

items.headline: Arbitral Damages GST ke under taxable nahi: Bombay HC
items.detail: Bombay High Court ne bola ki arbitral award ka damages ya settlement GST supply nahi maana jayega. Matlab yeh compensation section 7 CGST Act ke andar taxable nahi hai.
items.cga_view: Agar aapko business dispute mein damages mile hain toh GST ka liability ya return mein supply treat mat karo. Lekin similar disputes mein case facts check kar lo.

items.headline: TDR Exchange par capital gain lagega: ITAT ka decision
items.detail: ITAT ke according, agar aap existing land/building surrender karke TDR rights lete ho aur bechte ho, toh yeh transfer capital gain head mein taxable hai. Section 45 apply hoga.
items.cga_view: Agar aap TDR rights mein deal kar rahe ho toh capital gain calculation properly karo, supporting documents sambhal ke rakho. Surrender ka nature clear maintain karo.

items.headline: Sirf CBDT data pe Service Tax demand nahi chal sakta: CESTAT
items.detail: CESTAT Kolkata ne Service Tax demand set aside kar diya kyunki sirf CBDT/26AS data pe hi basis tha, independent verification nahi tha. Evidence aur due process ka hona zaroori hai.
items.cga_view: Agar aapke against only data-mismatch ki wajah se Service Tax demand aayi hai toh evidence aur proper procedure ki demand karo. Apne representation strong banao.

digests.summary: Aaj mostly GST aur Income Tax ke kuch important tribunal/court rulings aaye hain. Government ka koi new official circular nahi hai. Reporting mein clarity important hai.

items.headline: GST exclusion: ITAT ne Section 271B penalty hatai
items.detail: Mumbai ITAT ne kaha ki assessee ne apni turnover se GST hata, penalty nahi lagi kyunki uska yakin genuine tha. Yeh un logon par lagu hai jo GST ko tax audit turnover se exclude karte hain.
items.cga_view: Agar aapne GST ko exclude kiya aur penalty notice aayi, to ab tribunal ke is ruling ka reference de sakte hain. Par final view department pe depend karega.

items.headline: Bangalore ITAT: High-turnover comparables ALP mein exclude hue
items.detail: ITAT ne kuch high-turnover companies ko ALP se hata diya aur TDS credit bhi allow ki, as per Form 26AS. Transfer pricing matters mein relevant hai.
items.cga_view: ALP calculation mein agar comparables ka turnover bahut zyada hai, to aap bhi yeh reasoning try kar sakte hain. TDS credit galat show ho raha hai to ITAT order ka reference den.

items.headline: GST order ki sirf portal upload se appeal limitation start nahi hoti: Rajasthan HC
items.detail: Rajasthan High Court ne 645 din ki delay allow ki, bola proper service nahi hui thi toh sirf portal par order dalne se appeal ki limitation start nahi hoti.
items.cga_view: Agar order ki physical ya proper service nahi hui aur appeal ki time limit miss ho gayi hai, toh yeh HC ka decision helpfull ho sakta hai. Appeal file karte samay is order ka reference dein.

digests.summary: Aaj GST aur Income Tax se related kuch important tribunal rulings aur ek naya disclosure scheme hain. Official circulars aaj nahi mile.

items.headline: Stock-transfer pe penalty nahi, agar tax due hi nahi
items.detail: Tribunal ne bola Section 129 CGST Act ki penalty tab nahi lagegi jab goods pe koi tax payable nahi hai, chahe e-way bill na ho aur stock transfer ho.
items.cga_view: Agar aap stock transfer kar rahe hain aur e-way bill miss ho gaya, toh check karein koi tax due hai ya nahi, unnecessary penalty se bach sakte hain.

items.headline: GST order appeal allowed kyunki taxpayer ko notice hi nahi tha
items.detail: Telangana HC ne GST Section 74 order against appeal allow kar di, kyunki taxpayer ko pata hi nahi tha ki proceedings ho rahi hain, isliye delay bhi condone ho gaya.
items.cga_view: Agar aapko GST order bina proper communication mila ho, toh appeal consider karein, delay bhi maaf ho sakta hai.

items.headline: Foreign assets ke liye naya disclosure scheme, 2026 rules notified
items.detail: CBDT ne Foreign Assets Disclosure Scheme Rules, 2026 notify kar diye hain—isme valuation, eligibility aur filing ka process bataya gaya hai.
items.cga_view: Agar aapke paas foreign assets hain, toh nayi scheme aur rules dhyan se padhke timely disclosure karein. Compliance miss na karein.

items.headline: Section 87A ka rebate 111A STCG par bhi milega: Jaipur ITAT
items.detail: Jaipur ITAT ne bola ki Assessment Year 2024-25 ke liye Section 111A ke short-term capital gains par bhi Section 87A ka rebate mil sakta hai, chahe CBDT circular kuch bhi kahe.
items.cga_view: Agar aapka short-term capital gains 111A ke under hai, toh 87A rebate le sakte hain—return file karte waqt claim karein.

items.headline: High-turnover comparables exclude kiye ALP calculation mein: Bangalore ITAT
items.detail: Bangalore ITAT ne ALP calculation ke liye 4 high-turnover comparables ko hata diya, aur TDS credit Form 26AS ke hisaab se allow ki.
items.cga_view: Transfer pricing me high-turnover companies ko comparable na lein agar facts milte julte hain; Form 26AS ka TDS credit accurate claim karein.

digests.summary: Aaj court rulings pe focus raha, GST aur income tax dono mein important updates hain. Official notifications nahi aaye, lekin kuch compliance implications ho sakti hain.

items.headline: CESTAT Ahmedabad ne IGST ka time-barred demand khatam kiya
items.detail: CESTAT Ahmedabad ne interest, fine aur penalty hata diya, kyunki IGST ka demand time-barred tha aur proper charging provision nahi tha.
items.cga_view: Agar aapke against bhi aise old IGST demands pending hain, to apne consultant se matter dubara check karayein, appeal ka option ho sakta hai.

items.headline: Kerala HC ne GST show cause notice multiple years ka quash kiya
items.detail: Kerala HC ne bola ek hi GST show cause notice mein multiple years nahi ho sakte, alag notice chahiye. Intervening period limitation mein nahi aayega.
items.cga_view: Agar aapko bhi composite show cause notice mila hai, to is judgement ka reference deke clarification mangwayein ya challenge karein.

items.headline: SC: Sec 264 se return revise allowed nahi after deadline
items.detail: Supreme Court ne bola ki section 264 ka use karke prescribed time ke baad return revise nahi ki ja sakti. HC ka remand set aside kar diya.
items.cga_view: Deadline ke baad income tax return revise karne ki ummeed mat rakhein; planning aur filing time pe hi karein.

items.headline: ITAT Delhi: TPO se bina reference ALP decide nahi ho sakta
items.detail: AO ne bina TPO reference ke ALP decide kiya tha, jo galat bola gaya. Case assessment dobara hoga.
items.cga_view: Agar TP issue hai, to ensure karein ki AO TPO ko reference de, nahi to matter dobara open ho sakta hai.

digests.summary: Aaj mainly GST aur Income Tax/TDS se judi 5 important updates hain. Trade reports par based hai, isliye final action lene se pehle official notification zaroor check karein.

items.headline: CBDT ne TDS demand pe relief diya for inoperative PAN
items.detail: CBDT Circular No. 9/2025 ke hisaab se, agar deductee ya collectee ka PAN inoperative hai, to Section 206AA/206CC ke tehat zyada TDS/TCS nahi katega. Circular 21 July 2025 ko issue hua tha.
items.cga_view: Agar kisika PAN inoperative tha aur aapko higher TDS demand aaya hai, to yeh circular ka reference dena zaroori hai. Apne TDS records review karo.

items.headline: Delhi HC: GST seizure challenge ko reject kiya
items.detail: Delhi HC ne CGST Section 67(6) ke tehat seizure aur show cause notice proceedings ko separate maana hai. Taxpayer ko Section 130 notice ka jawab dena allowed kiya gaya hai.
items.cga_view: Agar aapke goods seize hue hain, to notice ka jawab dena compulsory hai. Court ka order cite kar sakte hain.

items.headline: Delhi HC ne judges ki ITR processing rok di
items.detail: Delhi HC ne judges ke PAN aur ITR details submit karne ko bola hai aur abhi sabhi tax demands, refunds aur processing pe stay laga diya hai jab tak case chalta hai.
items.cga_view: Sirf judges ya related parties ke cases mein hi apply hota hai, normal taxpayer par is order ka impact nahi hai. Public reporting purpose ke liye hai.

items.headline: Gujarat HC: Deceased proprietor par GST demand quash
items.detail: Gujarat HC ne ek aise taxpayer par GST demand quash kar diya jo mar chuke hain, bola aise proceedings ki koi legal validity nahi.
items.cga_view: Agar family member/firm mein aisa koi case hai, to turant legal heir ya representative ke naam pe GST compliance karayein. Purane deceased proprietor ke naam par demand valid nahi hai.

items.headline: ITAT Delhi: Section 40(a)(i) disallowance DTAA ke mutabik limited
items.detail: ITAT Delhi ne GE India ke case mein 100% Section 40(a)(i) ka disallowance sirf 30% tak restrict kiya under DTAA. PF-ESI disallowance bhi hataya gaya.
items.cga_view: Agar foreign remitance par 100% disallowance laga hai, to apne CA se DTAA benefit explore karwayein. Documentation pura rakhein.

digests.summary: Aaj ke digest mein ek ITAT Delhi ka important ruling hai, aur ek religious trusts ke GST/income-tax exemption par official clarification. CAAR Delhi ne bulk drugs import pe IGST rate bhi clear kiya hai.

items.headline: Religious trusts ke liye tax aur GST exemption
items.detail: Finance Ministry ne clarify kiya ki kuch services religious trusts ko income-tax mein exemption aur GST mein Notification No.12/2017-CT (R) ke under relief milta hai. Yeh eligible trusts aur unke specific activities par lagu hoga.
items.cga_view: Agar aap religious trust chala rahe hain to official exemption check karein, aur activity wise documentation ready rakhein audit ke liye.

items.headline: ITAT Delhi: Assessment u/s 143(3) invalid jab 153C lagu ho
items.detail: ITAT Delhi ne Akansha Gupta case mein bola ki jab seized documents hai, toh sahi provision section 153C hai, na ki 143(3). Assessment FY 2021-22 ke liye quash ho gaya.
items.cga_view: Aapke case mein search/seizure hua ho toh assessment section zaroor double-check karein. Galat section lage toh appeal ka scope hai.

items.headline: CAAR Delhi: Bulk drugs import pe 5% IGST lagu
items.detail: CAAR Delhi ne decide kiya ki agar bulk drugs/API imported hai aur wo Notification 10/2025 ke NIL-rated list mein nahi aata, toh 5% IGST lagta hai Sl. No. 226 ke under.
items.cga_view: Pharma ya bulk drug importer hain toh apne product ka notification check karein pura 5% IGST ya NIL rate claim ke liye, galat classification se penalty lag sakti hai.

digests.summary: Aaj GST aur Income Tax par 8 kaam ki baatein: mostly recent court rulings, compliance updates aur NPO registration par ek major advance.

items.headline: Section 83 GST attachment band ho jata hai ek saal ke baad
items.detail: Madras High Court ka kehna hai ki provisional bank attachment, Section 83 CGST Act ke under, ek saal se zyada continue nahi ho sakta. Court ne old attachment order ko set aside kar diya.
items.cga_view: Agar aapki company ka account 1 saal se zyada attached hai, toh turant application daaliye for release. Pure documents ready rakhein.

items.headline: SC ne GST appeal time badhaya technical glitch ki wajah se
items.detail: Supreme Court ne GST appeal file karne ka additional time allow kiya hai, jab technical problem ki wajah se delay hua tha. Ab appeal merits pe suni jayegi, limitation ki dikkat nahi rahegi.
items.cga_view: Agar aapka GST appeal deadline technical glitch se miss hua, toh abhi bhi file kar sakte hain. Saare system proof sambhal ke rakhein.

items.headline: Rajasthan HC: Online uploaded order, late appeal allowed
items.detail: Rajasthan HC ne GST appeal ka delay condone kiya, kyunki order sirf online upload hua tha, actual communication nahi hua. Section 107 limitation ab dhyan se dekhein.
items.cga_view: Aapka order sirf online aya aur delay hua appeal mein, toh aap bhi delay condonation ki application de sakte ho.

items.headline: Gujarat HC: GST refund ke liye Rule 89(4B) omission matter
items.detail: Gujarat HC ne GST order ko quash kar diya, kyunki Rule 89(4B) omit karne ke baad, bina saving clause ke, pending proceedings par bhi apply karta hai.
items.cga_view: Naye refund claims mein agar Rule 89(4B) ka issue aata hai, toh legal advice lekar challenge consider karein.

items.headline: Calcutta HC: Section 132 GST case mein trial rokne se mana
items.detail: Calcutta HC ne GST invoice violation case (Section 132) ki criminal proceedings rokne se inkaar kiya aur tax authorities se jawab manga hai.
items.cga_view: Agar aap par Section 132 ka case hai, toh abhi tak stay nahi mila, normal trial process follow karein. Legal help lein.

items.headline: NPO registration ke liye ab Form 104 lagega, 10A nahi
items.detail: CBDT ne NPO provisional registration ke liye simplified Form 104 introduce kiya hai, jo 10A ki jagah use hoga. Applicability 2025 se.
items.cga_view: Agar NGO/NPO run kar rahe ho, toh future registration/renewal ke liye Form 104 ka latest format check karo.

items.headline: Karnataka HC: Appeal wahi file hogi jahan AO baitha ho
items.detail: Karnataka HC ne bola: income tax appeal ki jurisdiction AO ke location pe depend karegi, assesee ke address pe nahi.
items.cga_view: Assessment order ka AO kis area ka hai, woh dekh kar right HC mein appeal file karein. Galat jurisdiction mein mat jaayen.

items.headline: Demonetization ke time medicine business ka profit 4% mana gaya
items.detail: ITAT ne decide kiya ki medicine business ka net profit demonetization period mein 4% of gross sales hi maana jayega, aur tax normal rates pe lagega.
items.cga_view: Demonetization ke duran sales pe agar aapka business scrutiny mein hai, toh yeh ruling refer kar sakte hain apne case mein.

digests.summary: Aaj ki digest mein mainly Income Tax forms ke naye updates hain jo 1 April 2026 se lagu honge. GST aur ek important tribunal decision bhi cover kiya gaya hai.

items.headline: PAN ke liye nayi Forms 93 aur 94 April 2026 se
items.detail: CBDT ne Form 49A ko hata ke Forms 93 (individuals) aur 94 (non-individuals) introduce kiye hain. PAN apply karne ka process simplify hua hai, effective 1 April 2026.
items.cga_view: Agar client PAN apply kare, to updated forms ka dhyaan rakhein. Old Form 49A use na karein.

items.headline: Foreign applicants ke liye PAN ab Forms 95 aur 96 se
items.detail: CBDT ne Form 49AA hata kar nayi Forms 95 aur 96 foreign applicants ke liye launch ki hain. PAN ka process simplify hua hai, 1 April 2026 se.
items.cga_view: Kisi bhi foreign entity ka PAN banana ho to naye forms 95/96 nazar mein rakhein, aur client ko update kar dein.

items.headline: Form 97/98: ab PAN transaction reporting ke liye simplified forms
items.detail: Forms 97 aur 98 (old 60N/61N) April 2026 se applicable hain. Filing requirements simplify hui hain; kuch extra document details chahiye honge.
items.cga_view: Agar aapko PAN se related reporting ya compliance karni hai, nayi forms ka format dekhein.

items.headline: TAN application ke liye ab Forms 134 aur 135
items.detail: Form 49B ab replace ho gaya hai. Government aur non-Government ke liye alag forms 134 aur 135 1 April 2026 se lagu hain.
items.cga_view: TAN apply karte waqt sahi naya form pilih karein, purane form 49B use na karein.

items.headline: GST Rule 14A: Simplified registration, eligibility Rs. 2.5 lakh/month B2B output
items.detail: GST Rule 14A ke tahat eligible taxpayers (B2B output tax liability up to Rs. 2.5 lakh/month) ko simplified registration ka option hai. Regular monitoring hoga.
items.cga_view: Agar aapka monthly B2B GST output Rs. 2.5 lakh se kam hai, toh advantages check karein. Eligibility clear karein pehle apply karne se pehle.

items.headline: Section 44AD nahi lagu jab taxpayer ne opt nahi kiya: Delhi ITAT
items.detail: Delhi ITAT ne addition reject ki, kaha section 44AD ka presumptive scheme zabardasti lagu nahi kiya ja sakta. Jab tak taxpayer khud opt na karein.
items.cga_view: Profit calculation ke liye scheme opt karne ka dhyaan rakhein; zabardasti presumptive nahi lagti, books maintain karne par apna case bana rahein.

items.headline: 90 lakh fake ITC case: Allahabad HC ne bail di, evidence kam tha
items.detail: Allahabad High Court ne fake GST input tax credit ke case mein, evidence nahi hone par accused ko bail di. Sirf allegation pe prosecution nahi ho sakta.
items.cga_view: Business ko apne GST trail aur documentation bilkul tight rakhna hai; mala fide transaction ka proof na ho, to department action defend ho sakta hai.

digests.summary: Aaj ka digest important TDS/TCS reporting, kuch recent court rulings, aur ek GST update cover karta hai. Official government source se koi naya notification nahi aaya hai.

items.headline: FY 2026-27 se naye TDS forms 138 & 140 lagenge
items.detail: Trade reports ke mutabik, Form 24Q/26Q ki jagah ab Form 138/140 use honge TDS filing ke liye, April 2026 se. Naye forms quarterly aur simplified kahe ja rahe hain.
items.cga_view: Clients abhi purane forms use karein, par FY 2026-27 ke liye team ko naye formats ki training dena shuru karein. Official notification ka intezaar rahe.

items.headline: TCS reporting FY 2025–26 mein ab bhi 27EQ form se
items.detail: Trade press ke hisaab se, Income Tax Act, 2025 ke mutabik abhi Form 27EQ hi TCS reporting ke liye use hoga for FY 2025–26. Quarterly filing ki timeline continue rehni hai.
items.cga_view: TCS ke clients ko abhi koi immediate badlav nahi karna, Form 27EQ hi timely submit karein. Team ko new Act pe update rakhna zaroori hai.

items.headline: Jodhpur ITAT: Late Form 10B ke bawajood Section 11 exemption mili
items.detail: Agar audit report CPC tak time pe pahunch jaaye toh late Form 10B filing par bhi Section 11 exemption mil sakta hai (ITAT Jodhpur ka case).
items.cga_view: Trusts/NGOs ke audit me delay ho toh yeh case ka reference rakhna, lekin har case alag hota hai - dependency assessment officer pe bhi hai.

items.headline: Supreme Court: CGST Rule 96(10) omission – pending refunds par bhi lagu
items.detail: Supreme Court ne decide kiya ki CGST Rule 96(10) ka jo omission hua hai, woh abhi ke pending GST refund cases par bhi lagu hoga jahan koi saving clause nahi diya gaya.
items.cga_view: Agar aapka GST refund case pending hai, toh yeh SC ka ruling aapke favour me help kar sakta hai. Refund follow-up me reference ka use karein.

items.headline: Gujarat HC: Assessment cancel hua, sirf 2 din reply time diya tha
items.detail: Gujarat High Court ne assessment aur penalty cancel kar diye, kyunki taxpayer ko sirf 2 din ka response time mila tha. Naya assessment conduct hoga.
items.cga_view: Agar assessment notices me kam samay mil raha hai toh turant objection file karein aur is HC ka example dikhayein. Fair hearing zaroori hai.

digests.summary: Aaj ki digest mein GST aur Income Tax par recent HC aur tribunal rulings cover ki gayi hain. Sab items verified sources se liye gaye hain, koi due date iss period mein nahi hai.

items.headline: TDS Paid u/s 195A Not Subject to Service Tax
items.detail: CESTAT Chandigarh ne decide kiya ki Section 195A ke under pay hua TDS service tax ke value mein include nahi hoga. Saath hi, jab tak suppression ya tax evasion ka intent nahi, extended limitation bhi apply nahi hogi.
items.cga_view: Agar aapne 195A ke under TDS pay kiya hai to service tax demand ke liye yeh order ka reference use kar sakte hain. Purane cases check karein, shayad refund ya relief mil sake.

items.headline: Panaji ITAT: Double Tax on Partner Salary Deleted
items.detail: Panaji ITAT ne 2.98 lakh double addition hata di, kyunki partner remuneration pe already partner ki personal return me tax kaata tha (AY 2013-14 ka case).
items.cga_view: Is ruling ko refer karein agar firm aur partner dono ki income pe tax dubara lag raha hai. Apni assessment order cross-check kar lein.

items.headline: ITAT Delhi: Wrong Section Used, Assessment Quashed
items.detail: Delhi ITAT ne assessment khatam ki jo Section 143(3) me thi, jabki matter 153C me initiate hona chahiye tha (AY 2021-22).
items.cga_view: Agar aap bhi similar notice ya assessment ka samna kar rahe hain, to section ki technicality jaankari lein. Galat section ho to appeal zarur karein.

items.headline: Karnataka HC: Multiple Year GST SCN Allowed
items.detail: Karnataka High Court ne bola GST show cause notice ek saath several saal ke liye consolidated issue ho sakta hai. Law me aisa ban nahi hai, lekin limitation period ka dhyaan rakhna hoga.
items.cga_view: Agar consolidated SCN mila hai to har saal ki calculation alag se verify karein. Limitation period cross-check karna must hai.

digests.summary: Aaj mostly HC/tribunal rulings hain GST aur Income Tax par, business owners ko notices & compliance process mein practical guidance mil sakti hai.

items.headline: Order galat address par chipkana – limitation nahi lagega
items.detail: CESTAT Allahabad ne bola ki GST order agar galat premise par chipkaya gaya toh appeal ki limitation nahi lagegi. Case dobara sunne bheja gaya.
items.cga_view: Agar apke office ki jagah kisi aur jagah order chipka ho, toh appeal late ho toh bhi valid ho sakti hai. Iss point ko apne records mein note karo.

items.headline: Karnataka HC: Multiple year GST notices allowed
items.detail: Karnataka HC ne clarify kiya ki consolidated GST show cause notices multiple years ke liye diya ja sakta hai. Limitation rules safe hai.
items.cga_view: Agar aapko ek hi notice mein kai saal ka GST poocha jaye toh challenge karna mushkil hoga; defence prepare karte waqt sab saal ka dhyan rakho.

items.headline: ITAT Delhi: Wrong section se assessment hua toh order quash ho sakta hai
items.detail: Delhi ITAT ne ek assessment ko isliye quash kiya kyunki sahi section (153C) mein notice nahi diya gaya, galat section (143(3)) mein kiya gaya tha.
items.cga_view: Aapka assessment ya notice sahi section mein hai ya nahi, yeh check karwana zaroori hai – galat section ho toh aap challenge kar sakte hain.

items.headline: Parallel GST proceedings ITC ke case mein allowed nahi – HP HC
items.detail: Himachal Pradesh High Court ne bola ki Central aur State GST authorities ek hi ITC dispute pe parallel proceedings nahi chala sakti. Case fresh consider hoga.
items.cga_view: Agar apke against ITC ka Central aur State dono jagah se notice hai, toh aapko ek hi proceeding mein combine karane ke liye application karwana chahiye.

items.headline: DRP ko timely objection nahi diya toh assessment challenge nahi hoga - Allahabad HC
items.detail: Allahabad High Court ne bataya ki agar aapne DRP ke samne timely objection nahi diya, toh assessment order court mein challenge nahi ho sakta.
items.cga_view: Assessment order milte hi DRP ke samne objection ki last date mat miss karo, warna legal remedy khatam ho jayegi.

digests.summary: Aaj ke digest mein High Courts aur CESTAT ke kuch kaafi important GST aur Income Tax rulings hain jo aapki compliance aur litigations strategy par effect daal sakte hain.

items.headline: Order galat jagah chipka toh appeal late nahi maana jayega
items.detail: CESTAT Allahabad ne bola ki agar GST order galat premises par chipka, toh appeal filing ki limitation start nahi hoti. Matter wapas de-novo proceeding ke liye bheja gaya.
items.cga_view: Agar aapko order properly serve nahi hua hai, toh appeal filing ka limitation period waise hi nahi chalega. Order ki service check karein pehle.

items.headline: Bar on parallel GST proceedings: Himachal HC ka naya decision
items.detail: Himachal Pradesh HC ne kaha ki ITC disputes mein central aur state authorities ek saath parallel proceedings nahi chala sakte. Fresh consideration ka order diya.
items.cga_view: Agar aapke khilaaf dono authorities proceedings chala rahi hain toh yeh decision cite kar ke ek proceeding rokwa sakte hain.

items.headline: APA forms aur process simplified by CBDT
items.detail: CBDT ne Advance Pricing Agreement (APA) ke forms revise kiye, ₹20 lakh fee standard rakhi, aur withdrawal, renewal process simplify kiya. Rules ab 2026 ke liye hain.
items.cga_view: Jo log APA process use karte hain, naye forms aur process ko check karein for fresh and renewal applications.

items.headline: Income Tax records dekhne advocate appointment allowed in liquidation
items.detail: Madras HC ne income tax advocate ko appointment ki permission di, taaki ₹6.29 crore ka department ka claim settle ho sake during liquidation process.
items.cga_view: Jo log winding up ya liquidation phase mein hain, advocates ko tax records review ke liye appoint karne ka yeh precedent use kar sakte hain.

digests.summary: Aaj major GST compliance aur MCA penalty news hain. Courts ne kuch latest GST aur Income Tax interpretations diye hain.

items.headline: J&K Mining Sector Par CBIC Naya GST Coordination Framework
items.detail: CBIC ne Instruction No. 01/2026-GST se J&K mining sector mein CGST-State mining coordination aur data sharing ko mandate kiya hai. Isse GST enforcement minerals sector mein jyada strong hoga.
items.cga_view: Minerals ya mining business wale Jammu-Kashmir mein compliance aur reporting mein ab zyada dikkat expect karein, additional scrutiny ki taiyari rakhein.

items.headline: GST Appeal Limitation Mein Rectification Ka Time Exclude Hoga: Gauhati HC
items.detail: Gauhati High Court ne bola, agar Section 161 ke rectification ke liye time diya gaya hai to appeal (Section 107) ki limitation nikalte waqt ye duration exclude hoga.
items.cga_view: Agar aap GST order ke rectification ke liye jaa rahe hain, appeals file karne ka waqt effectively badh jaata hai, lekin dates note karna zaroori hai.

items.headline: GST ITC (Truck & Cross Year) Claims Ko CA Certificate Chahiye: GSTAT
items.detail: Tribunal ne assessee ko kaha ki GST ITC ke verification ke liye CA certificate file karein aur ITC register dikhayein, taa ki confirm ho ki vehicle par GST claim mein depreciation nahi li.
items.cga_view: Truck ya vehicle par GST ITC claim cross-year karte ho to CA certificate aur saara backup ready rakho, nahi to aapka ITC atak sakta hai.

items.headline: MGT-7A Mein Galat Disclosure Par ₹5,000 Ka ROC Penalty
items.detail: ROC Mumbai II ne authorised signatory par ₹5,000 penalty lagayi hai kyunki annual return (MGT-7A) mein board meeting disclosure poora nahi tha.
items.cga_view: Company return file karte waqt board meetings aur compliance details galti se na chhodein, penalty seedha personal lag sakta hai.

items.headline: Trade Body Ko Section 12AA Registration Ka Right: Gujarat HC
items.detail: Gujarat HC ne decide kiya ki trade promotion association ko Section 12AA charitable registration mil sakti hai; Revenue ki appeal dismiss kar di.
items.cga_view: Apne objects clear dikhao, charitable registration possible hai agar criteria fulfill hai. Associations ko ye precedent help karega.

items.headline: GST Road Contract Mein Wrong GST Reimbursement Par Allahabad HC Ka Faisla
items.detail: Allahabad HC ne arbitral award set aside kiya kyunki arbitrator ne MoRTH SOP ko wrongly apply kiya, jab State order applicable tha.
items.cga_view: Contract drafting aur GST reimbursement ke clauses halke mein na lein, dispute hone par court contract ki exact language dekhega.

digests.summary: Aaj ke din, GST, IT, aur ek court ruling par kuch important updates hain. Official notification ka intezaar hai, sab trade press reports se hai.

items.headline: GSTAT ne Bengal Peerless par anti-profiteering case drop kiya
items.detail: GSTAT ne DGAP report ko maante hue bola ki Digangana Project mein GST ka koi extra ITC benefit nahi mila, isliye Section 171 ka matter close ho gaya.
items.cga_view: Agar aapka project bhi anti-profiteering ke under hai toh ye case helpful ho sakta hai. Apne documents DGAP ke liye ready rakhein.

items.headline: CBDT ka delay refund procedure: Section 119(2)(b)
items.detail: CBDT ne delayed income tax refund claims ke liye process explain kiya hai—kaun eligible hai, approval limits aur adjustment Section 245 ke under possible hai. Details abhi trade press report pe hain.
items.cga_view: Agar aapka refund delay ho raha hai toh Section 119(2)(b) ke under aap application consider kar sakte hai. Official circular ka wait karein aur CA se process check karva lein.

items.headline: Delhi ITAT: IBC moratorium mein Revenue appeal maintain nahi
items.detail: Delhi ITAT ne bola ki agar IBC moratorium chal raha hai toh income tax appeal maintain nahi hoti. Ye sirf trade press ki coverage hai, abhi official order ka link nahi.
items.cga_view: Agar aap IBC mein hain aur income tax ka matter chal raha hai toh apne CA ko order dikhayein, shayad aapko bhi stay ka benefit mil sakta hai.

items.headline: ITAT Bangalore: LLP conversion ke baad reassessment invalid
items.detail: Bangalore ITAT ne kaha ki company jab LLP ban gayi aur AO ko pata tha, fir bhi reassessment hua toh vo invalid hai. Official copy abhi link pe available nahi.
items.cga_view: Agar aapne company ko LLP mein convert kiya hai toh reassessment notices ka dhyan rakhein—galat notice aaye toh challenge kar sakte hain.

items.headline: GST Council ne IGST settlement reforms implement kiye
items.detail: GST Council ne IGST settlement ke liye new rules (GST Settlement of Fund Rules, 2026) notify kiye aur ITC reversal ka naya SOP lagu kiya. Abhi sab trade report par depend hai.
items.cga_view: Abhi IGST or cross-utilisation pe closely monitor karein—SOP ke official details aate hi process update karna padega.

digests.summary: Aaj ki digest mein GST refund par Gujarat HC ka ruling, TDS par ITAT Mumbai ka faydemand faisla, aur ek aur income tax assessment ki important clarification di gayi hai. Sab update trade press sources se hain, official notification ke intezaar mein rehna sahi rahega.

items.headline: Gujarat HC: GST Refund Circular Can't Restrict Section 54
items.detail: Gujarat High Court ne Circular No. 181/13/2022-GST ke basis par Section 54 refund reject karna galat bola hai. Court ne refund claims wapas process karne ko bola hai. Circular ki limitation pe Court ne clear stance diya hai.
items.cga_view: Agar aapka GST refund Circular 181/13/2022-GST ka hawala dekar reject hua, toh phir se claim file karo ya appeal karo. Official department ki new instructions ka intezaar bhi zaruri hai.

items.headline: Trade Discount Not Liable for TDS u/s 194H: ITAT Mumbai
items.detail: ITAT Mumbai ne bola, dealers ko diye trade discounts commission nahi hain, isliye inpe Section 194H TDS nahi katega. Specific Bajaj Auto case mein yeh ruling aayi hai.
items.cga_view: Agar aap dealers ko sirf trade discount dete ho, toh uss amount par 194H TDS katna abhi zaroori nahi lagta, par abhi bhi practice/facts check kar lo. Department se challenge ho sakta hai.

items.headline: Section 153C Limitation Counts From Assessing Officer Transfer: ITAT Delhi
items.detail: ITAT Delhi ne kaha, search ke baad assessment ki limitation period Section 127 transfer date se chalegi jab records common AO ko milte hain. Yeh clarity specifically reassessment cases mein apply hoti hai.
items.cga_view: Kisi bhi search case mein assessment limitation dekhte waqt Section 127 transfer date dhyan se verify karo. Ye ground assessment ko challenge karne mein kaam aa sakta hai.

digests.summary: Aaj GST aur Income Tax se related kuch key updates aaye hain, ek Bombay HC ka ruling bhi notable hai. MCA/ROC ya TDS se direct update nahi aaya.

items.headline: Bombay HC ne GST notice ko quash kiya
items.detail: Bombay High Court ne GST show cause notice aur adjudication order quash kar diya hai, kyunki Section 73 ki 3 months ki mandatory gap maintain nahi hui thi. Iss wajah se pura SCN aur order invalid ho gaya.
items.cga_view: Agar aapko bhi GST SCN mila hai aur lagta hai ki procedure follow nahi hua, toh legal review karwayein – case ban sakta hai.

items.headline: Taxation and Other Laws (Amendment) Bill, 2026 aaya
items.detail: Trade report ke mutabik naya Bill propose hua hai jo Income-tax Act, Finance Act wa Payment & Settlement Systems Act mein changes la sakta hai. Official detail ya notification abhi aana baaki hai.
items.cga_view: Filhaal koi immediate action nahi hai, lekin clients ke IT compliance pe nazar rakhein – Bill pass hone par impact ho sakta hai.

items.headline: CBDT ne HSBTE ko Section 10(46) exemption di
items.detail: HSBTE ko CBDT ne Section 10(46) ke under exempt kiya hai, kuch income aur conditions ke saath. Applicability AY 2024-25 se hogi. Detail notification trade press mein hai, official link ka intezaar hai.
items.cga_view: Agar kisi client ka HSBTE se transaction hai toh uski tax treatment review karein, exemption conditions dekhein.

digests.summary: GST aur Income Tax pe latest court judgments aaye hain, jo aapke ongoing cases aur compliance approach ko impact kar sakte hain. Official notifications aaj nahi aaye, isliye zyada focus important rulings par hai.

items.headline: Consolidated GST SCN across years valid: Gauhati HC
items.detail: Gauhati High Court ne bola ki Section 73/74 CGST Act ke hisaab se multiple saal ka ek hi show cause notice diya ja sakta hai, agar limitation period ke andar ho.
items.cga_view: Aapko agar ek hi SCN mein multiple years covered milta hai, toh alag se challenge karne ki jarurat nahi hai. Defence prepare karte waqt ye fact dhyan mein rakho.

items.headline: E-way bill expiry pe detention illegal if reason genuine: AP HC
items.detail: AP HC ne GST detention cancel kar diya jab e-way bill vehicle breakdown ki wajah se expire hua, aur pareshani ki koi tax evasion nahi thi.
items.cga_view: Agar aapka consignment vehicle breakdown ki wajah se delay hota hai, toh uska proof sambhal ke rakho. E-way bill expire hone par penalty avoid kar sakte ho.

items.headline: ITC denial matter: Interim relief by Karnataka HC
items.detail: Karnataka HC ne ITC denial case mein interim relief diya, jahan supplier return file nahi kar raha tha aur NCLT case pending tha.
items.cga_view: Jis supplier ne return file nahi kiya hai aur uspe NCLT case chal raha hai, toh ITC ka denial challenge kiya ja sakta hai. Apne documents ready rakho.

items.headline: Unverified portal info pe reassessment nahi chalegi: ITAT
items.detail: ITAT ne ruling di ki Income Tax Officers ko portal (ITBA/INSIGHT) ke data pe bina verify kiye assessment nahi kholni chahiye, kyunki galti ho sakti hai.
items.cga_view: Agar aap par sirf portal ke data pe case khola gaya hai, toh is precedent ko cite karke relief maang sakte ho.

items.headline: Unsecured loan/share application genuine if docs okay: ITAT
items.detail: ITAT ne bola ki sirf creditor ka entry operator se link hone par unsecured loan ya share application ko bogus nahi maana jaa sakta, agar records theek hain.
items.cga_view: Transaction ke pure documents aur bank records ready rakho; agar query aaye toh submit karo. Sirf suspicion pe addition nahi honi chahiye.

digests.summary: Aaj ke major updates GST aur Income Tax ki compliance aur rulings par based hain. Filhal koi official government release nahi mila hai.

items.headline: E-way Bill System mein naya rule August se
items.detail: Trade reports ke hisaab se, 1 August 2026 se bill-to/ship-to transactions mein ship-to GSTIN mandatory ho jayega aur e-way bill close karne ki ek new facility aayegi.
items.cga_view: Aapko systems jaldi hi update karwa lene chahiye, aur staff ko new rule batana zaroori hai. Official notification ka wait bhi karein.

items.headline: Section 16(2)(c) CGST: ITC reversal pe ambiguity
items.detail: Article mein ITC reversal, dubara avail karne, aur kuch legal rulings discuss kiye hain. Practical compliance issues highlighted hue hain, par abhi clarity nahi aayi hai.
items.cga_view: ITC claim karte waqt supplier ki compliance pakka karein, aur koi bhi reversal ya re-availment accounting records mein ache se track karein.

items.headline: Jewellery seizure: ITAT ka naya decision
items.detail: Bangalore ITAT ne decide kiya ki CBDT Instruction 1916 sirf prescribed jewellery quantity ko protect karta hai. Baaki seized jewellery par Section 69A lagega agar valid source nahi dikhaya.
items.cga_view: Agar jewellery disclose karni ho ya assessment chal raha hai, to prescribed limit dhyan mein rakhein aur har ek item ka source clearly document karein.

items.headline: GST Appeal me pre-deposit: Delhi HC ka view
items.detail: Delhi High Court ne bola ki Section 107(6) CGST ke liye appeal ka right SCN ki date se decide hoga, aur ye vested right hai.
items.cga_view: Agar aapka appeal under process hai to SCN ki date check karein; kisi bhi new amendment ko retro apply nahi hone dena chahiye.

digests.summary: Aaj Income Tax aur GST ke kuch court judgments aaye hain jo business owners ko impact kar sakte hain. Sab trade press se liye gaye hain, official notification ka intezaar bhi zaroor karein.

items.headline: Ahmedabad ITAT: Sirf 8% profit unaccounted sales par taxable
items.detail: Ahmedabad ITAT ne decide kiya ki agar aapke sales books mein nahi dikhaye hain, to poore sales amount par nahi, balki sirf 8% presumed profit par hi tax lagega. CIT(A) ki 6% estimate ko modify kiya gaya.
items.cga_view: Agar aap par similar unaccounted sales ka issue hai to apne CA se yeh recent judgment discuss karein, shayad relief mil sakti hai. Par yeh ruling sab cases pe apply nahi hoti.

items.headline: Bombay HC: GST penalty director par abhi nahi lagegi
items.detail: Bombay High Court ne ek company director par section 122(1A) CGST ke tehat penalty lagane se stay diya hai, aur bola ki yeh provision individuals pe apply nahi hota. Filhaal yeh sirf interim order hai.
items.cga_view: Agar aap director ho aur aisi notice aayi hai, to abhi relax kar sakte hain. Lekin final decision aana baaki hai, legal advise zaroor lein.

items.headline: Madras HC: GST notifications without Council ultra vires
items.detail: Madras HC ne decide kiya ki GST notifications agar GST Council ke recommendation ke bina hai, to woh invalid hai. Kuch notifications aur notices ko side pe rakha gaya hai.
items.cga_view: Agar aapko aisi GST demand ya notice mili hai jo Council ki recommendation ke bina hai, to apne consultant ko judgement dikhayein. Abhi further clarity aa sakti hai.

digests.summary: Aaj court aur tribunal ke kuch important rulings aaye hain GST aur Income Tax pe. MSME disallowance aur ITR utility pe bhi issues report hue hain.

items.headline: MSME Interest Disallowance: Appeal Nahi Banega Assessment mein
items.detail: ITAT ne bola MSME Act ke interest disallowance pe Income Tax ke scrutiny assessment ke appeal mein challenge nahi kiya jaa sakta. Yani is point pe appellate remedy nahi milegi.
items.cga_view: Agar aap MSME interest disallowance ka soch rahe ho, to is point par Income Tax scrutiny assessment mein appeal file karne ka faayda nahi. Advance planning rakho.

items.headline: Section 143(2) Notice Nahi Toh Reassessment Invalid: ITAT
items.detail: Agar ITR file karne ke baad Section 143(2) ka notice nahi diya toh reassessment pura invalid ho jayega - yeh ITAT ki ruling hai.
items.cga_view: Reassessment ya scrutiny notice aaya hai toh check karo Section 143(2) notice mila tha ya nahi. Nahi mila toh strong technical ground hai challenge ka.

items.headline: GST Demand Stay After ITC Reversal: Karnataka HC
items.detail: Karnataka HC ne GST ke Section 74 ke case mein interim stay diya, jahan petitioner ne adjudication order ko jurisdiction aur natural justice pe challenge kiya tha.
items.cga_view: Agar aapke against similar ITC reversal ke baad demand raise hua hai, to court mein challenge consider kar sakte ho. Order carefully padho, har case alag hota hai.

items.headline: Form 10B Filing Delay Condoned by Madras HC
items.detail: Madras HC ne Form 10B late filing ko condone kar diya (Section 119(2)(b)), bus cost ke payment pe, aur assessment proceed karne ko bola.
items.cga_view: Trusts/firms agar Form 10B late file hua hai, toh cost deke condonation petition consider kar sakte hain. Late filing par ab relief mil sakta hai, precedent hai.

items.headline: Madras HC: GSTR-2A/2B Mein Dikh Raha Unutilised ITC Par Tax Nahi
items.detail: Madras HC ne bola ki agar unutilised ITC GSTR-2A/2B mein reflected hai, toh uspar tax aur interest nahi banega, jab tak ITC reverse ho gaya hai.
items.cga_view: Agar aapka ITC system mein dikh raha hai par utilise nahi hua, toh demand aaye toh order rely kar sakte ho. GSTR-2A/2B reconciliation strong rakho.

items.headline: Section 80P Deduction on Bank Interest Allowed: Bangalore ITAT
items.detail: Bangalore ITAT ne bank deposit interest ko business income maana aur Section 80P(2)(a)(i) deduction allow kiya, previous HC decision se alag stand.
items.cga_view: Co-op societies apne interest income ke Section 80P claim ko phir se review karein. Har case ka fact pattern check karein, aur ITAT ka stand rely kar sakte hain.

digests.summary: Aaj GST aur Income Tax pe kuch important court judgments aaye hain, saath hi GSTN ne e-Way Bill wale naye changes filhaal rok diye hain. Abhi compliance routine pe hi kaam karo.

items.headline: GSTN naye e-Way Bill changes abhi hold pe
items.detail: GSTN ne 1 August se lagu hone wale e-Way Bill system ke enhancements abhi rok diye hain. Sabhi purane process hi abhi continue karenge, naye advisory/FAQ bhi withdraw kar liye gaye hain.
items.cga_view: Aap apne logistics ya IT system mein koi naya change mat kariye jab tak GSTN se official green signal na aaye. Compliance filing mein old method hi follow karo.

items.headline: ITC reversal sahi, lekin penalty form ki galti pe radd
items.detail: Gujarat HC ne decide kiya ki ITC toh reverse karna padega agar supplier ne tax nahi diya, lekin bina GST DRC-01A notice ke penalty nahi lag sakti.
items.cga_view: Agar aapko ITC reversal notice mile toh yeh check karein ki penalty ki process sahi follow hui hai ya nahi. Achhi documentation rakhein.

items.headline: Section 74 GST case: Documents ki supply pe fresh reply allowed
items.detail: Telangana HC ne kaha ki jab investigating officer documents supply kare, toh taxpayer ko fir se reply dena, personal hearing ka mauka milna zaruri hai.
items.cga_view: Agar aapke case mein seized documents milte hain, toh supplementary reply zaroor file karein aur hearing attend karein. Deadline ka dhyan rakhein.

items.headline: Reassessment notice invalid agar Rs 50L se kam income chhuti
items.detail: Mumbai ITAT ne rule kiya ki agar alleged escaped income ₹50 lakh se kam hai aur notice issue hui 3 saal baad, toh reassessment invalid hai.
items.cga_view: Past IT returns ka reassessment notice mila hai toh amount aur notice date check karein. Agar Rs 50 lakh ki threshold cross nahi hui toh strong case hai.

digests.summary: Aaj GST aur Service Tax ki kuch court rulings aayi hain, aur e-Way Bill enhancements abhi rok di gayi hai. Official notifications ka intezaar hai, kaam abhi waise hi chalega jaise ab tak tha.

items.headline: e-Way Bill enhancements abhi hold par hain
items.detail: GSTN ne e-Way Bill system mein 1 Aug 2026 se hone wale changes ko next order tak rok diya hai. Abhi purana process hi follow hoga, naye advisories ya FAQs bhi withdraw kar diye gaye hain.
items.cga_view: Naye e-Way Bill features ke liye koi change mat karo. Abhi kaam normal procedure par hi rakho jab tak official update na aaye.

items.headline: Telangana HC: GSTAT appeal mein 10% deposit maaf, IGST pehle pay hua
items.detail: Telangana High Court ne ek case mein GSTAT appeal ke liye 10% statutory pre-deposit waive kar diya—kyunki taxpayer pehle hi IGST bhar chuka tha. Yeh specific facts par based hai.
items.cga_view: Agar similar IGST aur CGST/SGST liability ka dispute ho to apne advisor se specific legal advice lo—waiver automatically sab cases mein nahi milega.

items.headline: Service Tax: 26AS aur ST-3 mismatch pe demand valid nahi
items.detail: CESTAT Mumbai ne bola ki sirf Form 26AS aur ST-3 ki mismatch pe Service Tax demand nahi ban sakti. Department ko aur strong basis chahiye.
items.cga_view: Agar aapko sirf mismatch ke reason se notice aaya hai, toh reply mein judicial precedent ka reference dein. Sari details legal advisor ke through prepare karein.

items.headline: GST Section 74: Seized documents ke baad fresh reply allowed
items.detail: Telangana HC ne order diya ki jab bhi seized documents taxpayer ko milen, toh fresh/supplementary reply, personal hearing aur time-bound adjudication allowed hai.
items.cga_view: Aapke case mein agar documents delay se mile hain, toh fresh representation ka mauka mil sakta hai. Legal strategy apne advisor ke saath tayar karein.
